ev-questions.saved-sets.ask: Would you like to change a saved set, or write a new one?

ev-questions.saved-sets-more.ask: Which saved set would you like to change?

ev-questions.listed-unreachable.say: Your account could not be reached, so only sets on this machine are shown.

ev-questions.listed-none.say: You have no saved question sets yet.

ev-questions.where-both.say: kept on this machine and on your account

ev-questions.listed-unconfirmed.say: The independent checker has not confirmed <titles>.

ev-questions.listed-refused.say: <name> on your account no longer meets the question rules. Choose it to fix it.

ev-questions.off-account.say: The question set <set> is no longer kept on your account.

ev-questions.set-not-kept.say: The question set <set> is kept on this machine only, since your account could not be reached. To try again later, run /ev-questions and ask to keep it on your account.

ev-questions.write-new-about.say: Starts a new set of questions.

ev-questions.change-for.say: Shows the whole set, for <pack>, so you can say what to change.

ev-questions.change-alone.say: Shows the whole set, with no pack, so you can say what to change.

ev-questions.change-about.say: Shows the whole set so you can say what to change.

ev-questions.fix-about.say: Shows what no longer meets the rules so it can be fixed.

ev-questions.first-set.say: You have no saved question sets yet, so we'll write your first one.

ev-questions.fix-said.say: <name> no longer meets the rules for a question set, so it needs fixing before a run can use it. I'll fix it and show you the result.

ev-questions.which-pack.ask: Which pack should these questions extend?

ev-questions.only-mine-about.say: No Evalation pack is read with them and no pack credits are used, so the run answers these questions and nothing else.

ev-questions.pack-about.say: Your questions cost nothing extra. The pack itself uses one pack credit when the run reads it. Your questions print after the pack's own, under User provided questions.

ev-questions.keeps-clauses.say: <pack> keeps the clauses its publisher wrote, so your questions can go with one of your Evalation packs or run on their own.

ev-questions.packs-unreachable.ask: Evalation could not be reached, so the packs that take extra questions cannot be shown. Try again, or write these questions to run on their own?

options.label: Try again
options.description: Checks again for the packs that take extra questions.

options.label: Run them on their own
options.description: Writes the set with no pack. No Evalation pack is read with them and no pack credits are used.

ev-questions.no-pack-takes.say: These questions will run on their own, with no pack.

ev-questions.source.ask: Where should the questions come from?

options.label: Questions I type
options.description: You write your own questions next.

options.label: Features a website claims
options.description: The features a web page lists are checked against the code.

options.label: Features a document claims
options.description: The features a pitch deck, product sheet or features list names are checked against the code.

ev-questions.document.say: Drag the file into this window, or type its full path, such as ~/Downloads/pitch.pdf.

ev-questions.claims.ask: Which of these claims should become questions?

ev-questions.type.say: Type your questions in your next message, in your own words, one sentence for each question.

ev-questions.name.ask: What should this question set be called?

ev-questions.name-about.say: Keeps the set under this name.

ev-questions.name-taken.say: A saved set already has that name.

ev-questions.checking.say: Checking your questions against the rules for a question set. An independent checker that did not write them judges each question on its own. This can take a few minutes.

ev-questions.dropped.say: I dropped '<words>', since it <why>. Say if you want it back.

ev-questions.split.say: Your question '<asked>' became <questions>, since it covers more than one topic and each topic is checked on its own.

ev-questions.split-claim.say: The claim '<asked>' became <questions>, since it covers more than one topic and each topic is checked on its own.

ev-questions.kept-organisation.say: <question> is kept as your organisation's, since only your organisation's own records can answer it.

ev-questions.kept-organisation-added.say: <question> is kept as your organisation's, since only your organisation's own records can answer it, and I added <added> to ask what the code does about the same risk.

options.label: Change something
options.description: Tell me what to change, and I check it again.

ev-questions.save-unchecked.ask: The plugin could not confirm that the independent checker passed <titles>, since the part of the plugin that confirms each pass was not running in this session. Save them unchecked, or change something?

options.label: Save them unchecked
options.description: Saves the set as shown. The run still reads them, and they are marked as not confirmed by the independent checker.

options.label: Change something
options.description: Tell me what to change, and I check it again.

ev-questions.save-unchecked-one.ask: The plugin could not confirm that the independent checker passed <titles>, since the part of the plugin that confirms each pass was not running in this session. Save it unchecked, or change something?

options.label: Save it unchecked
options.description: Saves the set as shown. The run still reads it, and the question is marked as not confirmed by the independent checker.

options.label: Change something
options.description: Tell me what to change, and I check it again.

ev-questions.keep-on-account.ask: Also keep this set on your account?

options.label: Keep it on my account
options.description: It is then there on another computer or after reinstalling, kept as you wrote it and never read by us.

options.label: Keep it on this machine only

ev-questions.next-run.say: Next time you run /ev-run with <pack>, you can tick <name>.

ev-questions.next-run-other.say: The packs you chose with /ev-packs leave out <pack>. In /ev-run, pick 'Choose which packs to run', tick <pack>, then tick <name>.

ev-questions.next-run-alone.say: Run /ev-run and choose Only my questions. This uses no pack credits.

ev-questions.unconfirmed-note.say: The run and its report treat unconfirmed questions like any others. Only /ev-questions shows that the independent checker did not confirm them.
